title: G-EVAL: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing evaluation scores assigned by the LLM evaluator (G-EVAL) to human-written summaries versus LLM-generated summaries (GPT-3.5), specifically analyzing categories partitioned by human judges' preferences to determine if the LLM evaluator disproportionately favors LLM-generated texts.
